scope: 12 anonymous synthetic ordinary programming-task artifacts; assessed against task.txt, final business inputs/code/configuration, response.txt and checks.json only.

summary.conclusion: All final artifacts satisfy their supplied task and current fixture conditions. Claims stay within local evidence; no hardware certification is inferred.
limitations: Both numeric cases were already satisfied before changes and the supplied observations do not discriminate intermediate rounding order.
One spawn trace captured exit 0 but empty stdout; a targeted independent rerun of the final existing smoke passed.
This blinded artifact review alone cannot establish a causal benefit of knowledge exposure, quantify cost savings, or certify real-hardware behavior.
